title: Rama hears a gigantic clamour of an army
introduction: Rama hears a gigantic clamour of an army nearby and asks Lakshmana to find out what it is. Lakshmana ascends a tree and informs Rama that Bharata's army is approaching towards their hermitage. Lakshmana expresses his apprehension to Rama, saying that Bharata's army may be coming there in order to kill both of them. An enraged Lakshmana says that he will kill both Bharata and Kaikeyi together with the army.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 96th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तां तथा दर्शयित्वा तु मैथिलीं गिरिनिम्नगाम् |
निषसाद गिरिप्रस्थे सीतां मांसेन चन्दयन्
verses.iast:
tāṃ tathā darśayitvā tu maithilīṃ girinimnagām |
niṣasāda giriprasthe sītāṃ māṃsena candayan
verses.translation: Having shown Mandakini River in that manner to Seetha, the daughter of Mithila, Rama set on the hill-side in order to gratify her appetite with a piece of flesh.

glosses.meaning: the daughter of the king of Mithila
in order to gratify her appetite

verses.devanagari:
इदं मेध्यमिदं स्वादु निष्टप्तमिदमग्निना |
एवमास्ते स धर्मात्मा सीतया सह राघवः
verses.iast:
idaṃ medhyamidaṃ svādu niṣṭaptamidamagninā |
evamāste sa dharmātmā sītayā saha rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Rama, whose mind was devoted to righteousness stayed there with Seetha, saying; "This meat is fresh, this is savoury and roasted in the fire."

verses.devanagari:
तथा तत्र आसतः तस्य भरतस्य उपयायिनः |
सैन्य रेणुः च शब्दः च प्रादुर् आस्ताम् नभः स्पृशौ
verses.iast:
tathā tatra āsataḥ tasya bharatasya upayāyinaḥ |
sainya reṇuḥ ca śabdaḥ ca prādur āstām nabhaḥ spṛśau
verses.translation: While Rama was thus sitting there the dust and clamour of Bharata's army, which was approaching, ascended into the sky.

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे त्रस्ताः शब्देन महता ततः |
अर्दिता यूथपा मत्ताः सयूथा दुद्रुवुर् दिशः
verses.iast:
etasminn antare trastāḥ śabdena mahatā tataḥ |
arditā yūthapā mattāḥ sayūthā dudruvur diśaḥ
verses.translation: Meanwhile, frightened by that gigantic clamour, the leaders of elephants and other animal - troops, in rut, were tormented and fled in different directions from there.

verses.devanagari:
स तम् सैन्य समुद्भूतम् शब्दम् शुश्रव राघवः |
तामः च विप्रद्रुतान् सर्वान् यूथपान् अन्ववैक्षत
verses.iast:
sa tam sainya samudbhūtam śabdam śuśrava rāghavaḥ |
tāmḥ ca vipradrutān sarvān yūthapān anvavaikṣata
verses.translation: Rama heard that sound generated from the army and also saw all those leaders of the animal-flock, running away from there.

verses.devanagari:
तामः च विद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा तम् च श्रुत्वा स निह्स्वनम् |
उवाच रामः सौमित्रिम् लक्ष्मणम् दीप्त तेजसम्
verses.iast:
tāmḥ ca vidravato dṛṣṭvā tam ca śrutvā sa nihsvanam |
uvāca rāmaḥ saumitrim lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam
verses.translation: Seeing those animals running away and hearing that clamour, Rama spoke to Lakshmana (son of Sumitra) of burning courage as follows:

verses.devanagari:
हन्त लक्ष्मण पश्य इह सुमित्रा सुप्रजाः त्वया |
भीम स्तनित गम्भ्हिरः तुमुलः श्रूयते स्वनः
verses.iast:
hanta lakṣmaṇa paśya iha sumitrā suprajāḥ tvayā |
bhīma stanita gambhhiraḥ tumulaḥ śrūyate svanaḥ
verses.translation: "Alas! O, Lakshmana! Sumitra is blessed with a noble son in you. Here is heard a tumultuous sound as terrific as that of a roaring cloud. See what it is."

glosses.meaning: is blessed with a noble son
as terrific as that of a roaring cloud

verses.devanagari:
गजयूथानि वारण्ये महिषा वा महावने |
वित्रासिता मृगाह् सिंहैः सहसा प्रद्रुता दिशः
verses.iast:
gajayūthāni vāraṇye mahiṣā vā mahāvane |
vitrāsitā mṛgāh siṃhaiḥ sahasā pradrutā diśaḥ
verses.translation: "The lordly elephants in the forest, the buffaloes in the great woods and the wild beasts frightened by lions are suddenly running away in various directions."

verses.devanagari:
राजा वा राज मात्रो वा मृगयाम् अटते वने |
अन्यद् वा श्वा पदम् किंचित् सौमित्रे ज्नातुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
rājā vā rāja mātro vā mṛgayām aṭate vane |
anyad vā śvā padam kiṃcit saumitre jnātum arhasi
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! You ought to find out whether it is a king or a prince roaming for a hunt or some other savage beast."

verses.devanagari:
सुदुश्चरो गिरिश्चायं पक्षिणामपि लक्ष्मण |
सर्वम् एतद् यथा तत्त्वम् अचिराज् ज्नातुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
suduścaro giriścāyaṃ pakṣiṇāmapi lakṣmaṇa |
sarvam etad yathā tattvam acirāj jnātum arhasi
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! This mountain is difficult of access even to birds. You ought to find out soon, all this in an accurate manner."

verses.devanagari:
स लक्ष्मणः सम्त्वरितः सालम् आरुह्य पुष्पितम् |
प्रेक्षमाणो दिशः सर्वाः पूर्वाम् दिशम् अवैक्षत
verses.iast:
sa lakṣmaṇaḥ samtvaritaḥ sālam āruhya puṣpitam |
prekṣamāṇo diśaḥ sarvāḥ pūrvām diśam avaikṣata
verses.translation: Lakshmana quickly ascended a Sala tree in flowering and looking towards all directions, saw towards eastern side.

verses.devanagari:
उदन् मुखः प्रेक्षमाणो ददर्श महतीम् चमूम् |
रथ अश्व गज सम्बाधाम् यत्तैर् युक्ताम् पदातिभिः
verses.iast:
udan mukhaḥ prekṣamāṇo dadarśa mahatīm camūm |
ratha aśva gaja sambādhām yattair yuktām padātibhiḥ
verses.translation: Looking in northern direction, Lakshmana saw a huge army, full of chariots, steeds and elephants accompanied by smart foot-soldiers.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् अश्व गज सम्पूर्णाम् रथ ध्वज विभूषिताम् |
शशंस सेनाम् रामाय वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tām aśva gaja sampūrṇām ratha dhvaja vibhūṣitām |
śaśaṃsa senām rāmāya vacanam ca idam abravīt
verses.translation: Lakshmana informed Rama about that army which was full of horses, elephants and chariots decorated with flags and spoke the following words also.

verses.devanagari:
अग्निम् संशमयतु आर्यः सीता च भजताम् गुहाम् |
सज्यम् कुरुष्व चापम् च शरामः च कवचम् तथा
verses.iast:
agnim saṃśamayatu āryaḥ sītā ca bhajatām guhām |
sajyam kuruṣva cāpam ca śarāmḥ ca kavacam tathā
verses.translation: "O, honourable brother! Extinguish the fire. Let Seetha occupy a hiding place. Make your bow ready with a bow-string and arrows. Wear an armour."

verses.devanagari:
तम् रामः पुरुष व्याघ्रो लक्ष्मणम् प्रत्युवाच ह |
अन्ग अवेक्षस्व सौमित्रे कस्य एताम् मन्यसे चमूम्
verses.iast:
tam rāmaḥ puruṣa vyāghro lakṣmaṇam pratyuvāca ha |
anga avekṣasva saumitre kasya etām manyase camūm
verses.translation: Rama the tiger among men replied to Lakshmana, saying: "O, Lakshmana! See, whose army do you think is this?"

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्क्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्माणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् |
दिधक्षन्न् इव ताम् सेनाम् रुषितः पावको यथा
verses.iast:
evam ukktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmāṇo vākyam abravīt |
didhakṣann iva tām senām ruṣitaḥ pāvako yathā
verses.translation: Hearing Rama's words, Lakshmana was irritated like a fire and spoke the following words, as though he was wishing to scorch the army.

glosses.meaning: was irritated paavako yathaa = like a fire

verses.devanagari:
सम्पन्नम् राज्यम् इग्च्छमः तु व्यक्तम् प्राप्य अभिषेचनम् |
आवाम् हन्तुम् समभ्येति कैकेय्या भरतः सुतः
verses.iast:
sampannam rājyam igcchamḥ tu vyaktam prāpya abhiṣecanam |
āvām hantum samabhyeti kaikeyyā bharataḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: "Bharata, Kaikeyi's son, having obtained coronation and desirous of making the kingdom free of enemies, is coming here to kill both of us. It is clear."

verses.devanagari:
एष वै सुमहान् श्रीमान् विटपी सम्प्रकाशते |
विराजत्य् उद्गत स्कन्धः कोविदार ध्वजो रथे
verses.iast:
eṣa vai sumahān śrīmān viṭapī samprakāśate |
virājaty udgata skandhaḥ kovidāra dhvajo rathe
verses.translation: "The gigantic and glorious tree with superb branches is shining over there prominently. The ensign bearing the device of a kovidara (pomegranate) tree is shining on that chariot."

glosses.meaning: the ensign bearing the device of a Kovidara (pomegranate) tree

verses.devanagari:
भजन्त्य् एते यथा कामम् अश्वान् आरुह्य शीघ्रगान् |
एते भ्राजन्ति सम्हृष्टा जगान् आरुह्य सादिनः
verses.iast:
bhajanty ete yathā kāmam aśvān āruhya śīghragān |
ete bhrājanti samhṛṣṭā jagān āruhya sādinaḥ
verses.translation: Among the cavalry, some are cavorting merrily on their swift horses, while others are beaming with delight, mounted on their elephants.

verses.devanagari:
गृहीत धनुषौ च आवाम् गिरिम् वीर श्रयावहे |
अथवेहैव तिष्ठावः सन्नद्धावुद्यतायुधौ
verses.iast:
gṛhīta dhanuṣau ca āvām girim vīra śrayāvahe |
athavehaiva tiṣṭhāvaḥ sannaddhāvudyatāyudhau
verses.translation: "O, warrior! Let us take up our bows and ascend the mountain or let us stay here itself, fully prepared with our weapons in our hands."

glosses.meaning: with our weapons in our hands.

verses.devanagari:
अपि नौ वशम् आगग्च्छेत् कोविदार ध्वजो रणे |
अपि द्रक्ष्यामि भरतम् यत् कृते व्यसनम् महत्
त्वया राघव सम्प्राप्तम् सीतया च मया तथा |
verses.iast:
api nau vaśam āgagcchet kovidāra dhvajo raṇe |
api drakṣyāmi bharatam yat kṛte vyasanam mahat
tvayā rāghava samprāptam sītayā ca mayā tathā |
verses.translation: "O, Rama! Will that flag with the insignia of a Kovidara tree come into our subjugation? Can we see Bharata, because of whom a great misfortune has occurred to you, to Seetha and to me?"

glosses.meaning: will this flag with the insignia of a Kovidara tree

verses.devanagari:
यन् निमित्तम् भवान् राज्याच् च्युतो राघव शाश्वतीम् |
सम्प्राप्तो अयम् अरिर् वीर भरतो वध्य एव मे
verses.iast:
yan nimittam bhavān rājyāc cyuto rāghava śāśvatīm |
samprāpto ayam arir vīra bharato vadhya eva me
verses.translation: "O, Rama the warrior! By the reason of whom you were deprived of an eternal kingdom, such Bharata as a foe who is coming here, deserves to be slain by me."

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्य वधे दोषम् न अहम् पश्यामि राघव |
पूर्व अपकारिणम् हत्वा न ह्यधर्मेण युज्यते
verses.iast:
bharatasya vadhe doṣam na aham paśyāmi rāghava |
pūrva apakāriṇam hatvā na hyadharmeṇa yujyate
verses.translation: "O, Rama! I see no sin in slaying Bharata. None is charged with unlawfulness, if one strikes down an aggressor."

glosses.meaning: the one who has hurt another before
non is charged adharmaNa = with unlawfulness.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वापकारी भरतस्य्तक्तधर्मश्च राघव |
एतस्मिन्न् निहते कृत्स्नाम् अनुशाधि वसुंधराम्
verses.iast:
pūrvāpakārī bharatasytaktadharmaśca rāghava |
etasminn nihate kṛtsnām anuśādhi vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: "Bharata is the assailant and his death is legitimate. He being dead, you will rule the entire earth."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य पुत्रम् हतम् सम्ख्ये कैकेयी राज्य कामुका |
मया पश्येत् सुदुह्ख आर्ता हस्ति भग्नम् इव द्रुमम्
verses.iast:
adya putram hatam samkhye kaikeyī rājya kāmukā |
mayā paśyet suduhkha ārtā hasti bhagnam iva drumam
verses.translation: "Let Kaikeyi, who is craving for the kingdom see, with great sorrow, her son slain by me today in battle, as a tree is crushed down by an elephant."

glosses.meaning: who is craving for the kingdom
is crushed down by an elephant.

verses.devanagari:
कैकेयीम् च वधिष्यामि सानुबन्धाम् सबान्धवाम् |
कलुषेण अद्य महता मेदिनी परिमुच्यताम्
verses.iast:
kaikeyīm ca vadhiṣyāmi sānubandhām sabāndhavām |
kaluṣeṇa adya mahatā medinī parimucyatām
verses.translation: "I shall kill Kaikeyi too along with her friend the hunch-back and other accomplices. Let the earth today be relieved of a great sinner."

glosses.meaning: along with her friend the hunch-back
and other accomplices madinii = Le the earth

verses.devanagari:
अद्य इमम् सम्यतम् क्रोधम् असत्कारम् च मानद |
मोक्ष्यामि शत्रु सैन्येषु कक्षेषु इव हुत अशनम्
verses.iast:
adya imam samyatam krodham asatkāram ca mānada |
mokṣyāmi śatru sainyeṣu kakṣeṣu iva huta aśanam
verses.translation: "O, warrior bestowing an honour! Today in the concentrated fury that injustice has kindled I shall scatter the enemy - battalions as a fire consumes the dry wood."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य एतच् चित्र कूटस्य काननम् निशितैः शरैः |
चिन्दन् शत्रु शरीराणि करिष्ये शोणित उक्षितम्
verses.iast:
adya etac citra kūṭasya kānanam niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
cindan śatru śarīrāṇi kariṣye śoṇita ukṣitam
verses.translation: "Today, with my sharpened arrows, I shall slay the bodies of my foes and make this forest of Chitrakuta overflow with blood."

verses.devanagari:
शरैर् निर्भिन्न हृदयान् कुन्जरामः तुरगामः तथा |
श्वापदाः परिकर्षन्तु नराः च निहतान् मया
verses.iast:
śarair nirbhinna hṛdayān kunjarāmḥ turagāmḥ tathā |
śvāpadāḥ parikarṣantu narāḥ ca nihatān mayā
verses.translation: "The elephants and horses whose breasts were laid open with my darts and the men too struck down by me, be dragged about by savage beasts."

verses.devanagari:
शराणाम् धनुषः च अहम् अनृणो अस्मि महा वने |
ससैन्यम् भरतम् हत्वा भविष्यामि न संशयः
verses.iast:
śarāṇām dhanuṣaḥ ca aham anṛṇo asmi mahā vane |
sasainyam bharatam hatvā bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "By killing Bharata together with his army in this great forest, I shall discharge my debt to my bow and arrows."
